description: A community-made Paper gamemode inspired by the Minecraft Nations project, featuring teams, lives, combat logging, bananas and elimination mechanics.
body:
# 🍌 ReicheModus

ReicheModus is a community-made Paper gamemode inspired by the Minecraft Nations project.

Build your nation, protect your team's banana, survive PvP battles and eliminate rival teams. Every player has a limited number of lives, making every fight meaningful.

## Core Features

### ❤️ Lives System

* Configurable starting lives
* Lose a life on death
* Automatic elimination at 0 lives
* Eliminated players become spectators

### ⚔ Combat System

* Combat tagging
* ActionBar combat timer
* Combat logging punishment
* Configurable combat duration

### 🍌 Banana Objective

* Every team owns a banana
* Only the owning team can place its banana
* Enemy teams can steal bananas
* Persistent banana locations

### 👥 Team Management

* Create and manage teams
* Join and leave teams
* Team ownership system
* Kick team members

### 📊 Live Scoreboard

* Team information
* Remaining lives
* Combat status
* Banana status

### 💾 Persistent Storage

* Player data saved automatically
* Team data saved automatically
* Survives server restarts

## Commands

### Players

* `/team create <name>`
* `/team join <team>`
* `/team leave`
* `/team kick <player>`
* `/team info`
* `/team list`
* `/lives`

### Administrators

* `/reiche start`
* `/reiche stop`
* `/reiche reload`
* `/reiche status`
* `/givebanane <team>`

## Requirements

* Paper 1.21.11
* Java 21

## Disclaimer

This is a community-created project inspired by the Minecraft Nations concept and is not affiliated with the original Minecraft Nations organizers.
